- Surround View Camera System
- P&P Park & Unpark Assist with Stop System
- Uconnect 5 Nav with 10.1 Display
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Leather Trimmed Bucket Seats
- HD Trailer Tow Package with Trailer Brake Control

This Series III comes equipped with a 5.7L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and full-time 4WD, providing the torque and control needed for varied road conditions. The vehicle achieves 15 mpg in city driving and 20 mpg on the highway, balancing power delivery with reasonable efficiency expectations for its class.

The interior showcases genuine wood accents throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels, complemented by leather-trimmed seating for up to seven passengers. The front seats offer heating and ventilation functions, while the second and third rows benefit from dedicated heating capability. A memory system allows the driver and front passenger to store preferred seating positions, and the heated steering wheel adds comfort during cold weather operation.

Technology features include the Uconnect 5 navigation system displayed on a 10.1-inch touchscreen, AM/FM radio with SiriusXM 360L satellite capability, and a premium 10-speaker audio system with steering wheel controls. The Heads-Up Display projects key driving information directly into your line of sight, while the Front Passenger Interactive Display keeps all occupants engaged with the vehicle's systems.

Safety and convenience systems include the Surround View Camera System for complete visibility around the vehicle, Drowsy Driver Detection to monitor driver alertness, and Intersection Collision Assist to help prevent cross-traffic incidents. This 2022 Jeep Gladiator Overland in Blue represents a capable truck built for both work and adventure, offering genuine utility with refined comfort features that make every drive more enjoyable.

- Quick Order Package 24N High Altitude
- Trailer Tow Package with Class IV Receiver Hitch
- 3.6L V6 24V VVT Engine with 8-Speed Automatic
- Cold Weather Group with Heated Steering Wheel and Remote Start
- Sport Suspension with Dana M210 Wide Front and M220 Wide Rear Axles
- Uconnect 4C Navigation with 8.4 Display and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- LED Premium Reflector Headlamps with LED Fog and Tail Lamps
- ParkSense Rear Park Assist with ParkView Back-Up Camera

The 3.6L V6 engine delivers the power you need whether hauling cargo or navigating challenging terrain, paired with an 8-Speed Automatic transmission that balances performance with everyday driving comfort. The High Altitude package enhances capability with upgraded cooling and electrical systems, while the Sport Suspension tuning provides responsive handling on both highway and off-road surfaces.

Building on the Gladiator's truck heritage, the Overland trim brings premium interior appointments with leather-trimmed bucket seats, caramel interior accents, and a wrapped instrument panel bezel. The heated steering wheel and remote start system prove especially valuable during cold weather, while dual-zone climate control ensures comfort for all occupants. The full-length floor console with premium armrest provides convenient storage and organization for essentials.

Safety technology integrates seamlessly into your driving experience through blind spot detection, cross path detection, and the ParkSense rear park assist system. The backup camera displays on the navigation screen, making parking and reversing straightforward. ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to help protect you and your passengers.

The Trailer Tow Package equips this truck with serious hauling capability, including the Class IV receiver hitch, 240-amp alternator, and heavy-duty engine cooling. The 3.73 rear axle ratio supports towing demands while maintaining highway cruising comfort. LEDs throughout headlamps, fog lamps, and taillamps enhance visibility and provide distinctive styling that sets this truck apart.

With premium features like the MOPAR spray-in bedliner protecting the truck bed and the hardtop headliner adding durability to the interior, this Gladiator is equipped for real-world use. The sliding rear window and freedom panel storage bag offer practical versatility for both work and weekend adventures. At just over 33,000 miles, this truck has been well-maintained and remains in excellent condition.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this Gladiator in person. Whether you're evaluating capability, interior comfort, or long-term value, this truck deserves your consideration. Our team looks forward to discussing how this vehicle meets your needs.

- Heated & Ventilated Front Bucket Seats
- Heated/Ventilated 2nd Row Power VIP Lounge Seats
- Power 2nd-Row Moonroof
- Navigation System
- Leather Seat Trim with SX Prestige Seat Package
- 12 Speakers with SiriusXM and HD Audio System
- Driver's Seat Integrated Memory System
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone A/C
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Power Liftgate

The cabin welcomes you with heated and ventilated seating throughout, while the power moonroof floods the interior with natural light. Climate control reaches every row front dual zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning ensure passenger comfort regardless of seating position. The available heated steering wheel adds another layer of convenience during colder months.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily driving. The navigation system paired with a 12-speaker audio system keeps you connected and entertained, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto bring your smartphone's functionality directly to your fingertips. SiriusXM keeps your entertainment options endless.

Practical features make everyday life easier. The power liftgate opens and closes automatically, the exterior parking camera rear helps with maneuvering in tight spaces, and the driver's seat integrated memory system recalls your preferred position. Luxury carpeted floor mats and a cargo mat protect your investment while maintaining the premium interior aesthetic.

Performance comes from a V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, delivering capable power while achieving 19 city and 26 highway fuel economy. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides stability and accessibility for family transportation.

Safety systems throughout the vehicle provide peace of mind. Dual front and side impact airbags, emergency communication, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to protect your passengers. The security system and panic alarm add additional layers of protection.

The gray exterior complements the refined SX Prestige trim, while 19-inch alloy wheels and power door mirrors with heating elements showcase attention to detail. This minivan represents a smart choice for families seeking reliable transportation with the comfort features that matter most.

description:
This 2024 Cadillac Escalade ESV Premium represents a substantial investment in full-size luxury with three rows of refined seating and an commanding presence on the road.

- Dark Moon Blue Metallic exterior finish
- Brandy leather seating with full grain leather and faceted quilting
- Fine Line Brandy wood trim accents
- 19-speaker AKG Studio audio system with SiriusXM 360L
- 16.9 diagonal OLED infotainment display
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Power panoramic tilt-sliding sunroof
- 22 14-spoke polished alloy wheels
- Heated and ventilated front seats with heated rear seats
- Heated steering wheel
- All-wheel drive with premium smooth ride suspension
- Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking and Reverse Automatic Braking
- Reconfigurable heads-up display
- Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist

The 3.0L turbocharged six-cylinder engine delivers dependable performance paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive capability. The Escalade ESV achieves 20 mpg city and 26 mpg highway, providing respectable efficiency for a vehicle of this size and capability. An engine block heater is included for enhanced cold-weather starting.

Interior comfort extends throughout the cabin with eight-way power front seat adjusters, four-way power lumbar support, and memory functions for both driver and passenger seats. The expansive three-row configuration offers flexible seating with split-folding rear seats, accommodating your family's varying needs. Climate control includes automatic temperature regulation with front dual zone and rear air conditioning systems.

Technology and safety converge throughout this Escalade ESV with an industry-leading suite of driver assistance features. Lane change alerts with side blind zone monitoring, rear cross traffic alerts, and rear camera mirror functionality provide enhanced awareness. The vehicle supports both wired and wireless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the navigation system and trip computer assist with route planning and vehicle diagnostics.

The all-wheel drive system works in concert with four-wheel independent suspension and a mechanical limited-slip differential to deliver confident handling. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and multiple airbag technologies establish a comprehensive safety foundation. OnStar emergency communication and Cadillac connected services provide additional peace of mind.

This Escalade ESV Premium combines luxury appointments with practical family capability. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the craftsmanship, technology integration, and versatile interior space firsthand.

description:
This 2023 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali Ultimate in Sterling Metallic Silver represents the pinnacle of premium truck capability and refined comfort. With its powerful EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck delivers the performance and capability you expect from a Denali.

- Super Cruise hands-free driver assistance with automatic lane changing and 3-year subscription
- Bose Premium Series 12-speaker audio system with SiriusXM 360L
- Premium GMC Infotainment System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- 15-inch multicolor head-up display
- Spray-on pickup bed liner with Denali logo and Vader Chrome signature grille
- Full grain leather heated and ventilated front seats with 16-way power adjustment
- Heated 2nd row outboard seats
- Power moonroof and power sliding rear window
- Denali Premium Suspension with adaptive ride control
- Wireless phone projection and charging
- HD surround vision with bed view and trailer cameras
- Advanced trailering package with integrated brake controller and tire pressure monitoring
- Lane keep assist with departure warning and automatic emergency braking
- Ultrasonic front and rear park assist with rear cross traffic braking
- 22-inch 7-spoke ultra-bright machined alloy wheels

The Denali Ultimate trim sets itself apart with meticulous attention to detail throughout the cabin. Genuine wood accents on the dashboard, door panels, and console insert create an upscale environment, while the power moonroof and ambient lighting enhance the driving experience. The truck achieves approximately 15 mpg in city driving and 19 mpg on the highway, balancing the V8's capability with reasonable efficiency.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily driving through the Super Cruise system, which provides hands-free operation on compatible roads, plus the three-year subscription included with this truck. The infotainment system connects effortlessly with your devices, offering multiple charging options including wireless charging and USB ports positioned throughout the cabin. OnStar and GMC Connected Services keep you informed and in control.

Safety features extend beyond the essentials with enhanced automatic emergency braking, front pedestrian braking, rear pedestrian detection, and trailer side blind zone alerts. The adaptive suspension adjusts to road conditions automatically, while traction control and hill descent control manage challenging terrain with confidence. The 4-wheel disc ABS braking system provides reliable stopping power in any situation.

The bed is equipped for serious work with the spray-on liner bearing the Denali logo, chrome recovery hooks, and integrated trailering provisions. The truck bed mounted 120-volt power outlet and hitch guidance system with integrated trailer brake controller make towing straightforward and manageable.

This Sierra 1500 Denali Ultimate combines luxury, capability, and advanced technology into a single impressive package. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the commanding presence and refined interior that define this truck.

- 14-Speaker Meridian Audio System with SiriusXM

The three-row layout includes a split-bench third row that reclines to accommodate seven passengers or provides generous cargo flexibility. Front bucket seats feature full SynTex trim with heating and ventilation, while the power-adjustable driver seat with thigh support and memory settings ensures personalized comfort across multiple drivers.

Safety systems include a comprehensive airbag array, 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction management. The automatic emergency communication system provides peace of mind for you and your passengers. Rear anti-roll bars and four-wheel independent suspension contribute to controlled handling while navigating varied road conditions.

Technology integration makes every journey more convenient. The Meridian audio system delivers expansive sound through fourteen speakers, while SiriusXM satellite radio, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto keep you connected. A built-in navigation system eliminates guesswork, and the HomeLink garage door transmitter adds seamless access to your home.

Practical features enhance everyday usability. The power moonroof creates an open-air atmosphere, auto-dimming door mirrors and headlights reduce glare, and heated mirrors clear morning frost efficiently. Telescoping and tilt steering wheels accommodate your preferred driving position. Split-folding rear seats transform cargo space on demand.

The Telluride Hybrid X-Line SX combines family capacity with efficient hybrid performance, making it an intelligent choice for buyers seeking versatility without compromise. Price includes $699 of dealer added accessories.

description:
The 2027 Kia Telluride Hybrid X-Line SX Prestige in Gray represents a sophisticated choice for those seeking a capable three-row vehicle built on a foundation of quality engineering and thoughtful design.

- 14 Speaker Meridian Audio System with SiriusXM
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Power moonroof
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats
- Heated steering wheel
- 10-way power driver seat with thigh support
- Heated rear seats
- Heads-up display
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass
- Power liftgate
- Auto-leveling suspension with four-wheel independent design
- Speed-sensing power steering
- Advanced airbag system including knee and overhead airbags
- Emergency communication system with 911 Connect
- Exterior parking camera rear

This hybrid powertrain combines a 2.5L 4-cylinder engine with a 6-speed automatic transmission and AWD capability, offering a practical approach to efficiency without sacrificing the utility you need from a three-row vehicle. The suspension architecture delivers composed handling through its four-wheel independent setup and auto-leveling technology, while speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving conditions.

The cabin reflects a commitment to passenger comfort and connectivity. Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning ensures everyone stays comfortable, while the 14-speaker Meridian audio system paired with SiriusXM and smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps you entertained throughout your journey. Memory functions for both seats and the steering wheel mean your preferences are restored automatically each time you enter the vehicle.

Safety has been integrated throughout the design. Electronic stability control works alongside traction control to maintain your command on various road surfaces, while the comprehensive airbag system provides protection across multiple points. A rearview camera, low tire pressure warning, and 911 Connect emergency communication system round out the safety features. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power.

Practical features support daily living with this vehicle. The split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row bench provide flexible cargo configurations for passengers or goods. The power moonroof brings natural light and openness to the cabin, while the heated and ventilated front seats and heated rear seats adapt to seasonal conditions. Heated door mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, and fully automatic headlights help you navigate varying weather conditions with less effort.

The exterior presents a polished appearance finished in black with 20-inch silver multi-spoke aluminum wheels. Automatic headlights with delay-off functionality and front fog lights enhance visibility, while rain-sensing wipers and a rear window wiper handle precipitation without distraction. Power door mirrors with heating and turn signal indicators, combined with a power liftgate, streamline daily operation.

Black leather-trimmed bucket seats feature eight-way power adjustments, lumbar support, heating, and ventilation to keep you comfortable during long drives. The heated steering wheel and premium overhead console add to the upscale feel, while the full-length upgraded floor console provides practical storage.

Blind spot and cross path detection, full speed forward collision warning plus, lane keep assist, and adaptive cruise control with stop function provide layers of protection. The digital rearview mirror and auto high beam headlamp control further enhance safety and convenience.

Towing and hauling capabilities are enhanced by the power black tow mirrors with memory and convex spotter, trailer tow mirrors, and trailer reverse guidance. The electric shift-on-the-fly transfer case makes engaging 4WD simple and efficient. LED bed lighting illuminates your cargo area, and the MOPAR spray-in bedliner protects the bed from damage.

This Power Wagon is equipped with a comprehensive level 2 equipment group, towing technology group, and safety group. From heated second row seats and rain-sensing wipers to body color door handles and mirror running lights, every detail enhances your experience behind the wheel.

This Bronco has the 4.27 electronic locking rear axle a driver-selectable rear differential lock with short 4.27 gearing behind it. That is not a comfort feature and it is not decoration. A locker mechanically ties the rear wheels together so that when one lifts or loses grip, the other still pulls. This 2021 Ford F-150 XLT delivers the capability and technology you need for work and adventure, backed by a clean Carfax and highly equipped with premium features.

- 3.5L PowerBoost Full-Hybrid V6 with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- FX4 Off-Road Package with Rock Crawl Mode and Hill Descent Control

This F-150 XLT combines efficiency and durability with the 3.5L PowerBoost hybrid engine delivering 24 city and 24 highway MPG. The comprehensive FX4 Off-Road Package includes off-road tuned front shock absorbers, monotube rear shocks, electronic locking differential with 3.73 axle ratio, and skid plates for fuel tank, transfer case, and front differential. Rock Crawl Mode and Hill Descent Control give you confidence on challenging terrain, while the 4x4 capability ensures you're ready for any condition.

The gray exterior is complemented by premium styling touches including chrome accents, a 2-bar grille design, and your choice of 18 or 20 wheel options. The truck bed features a tray-style floor liner, power-sliding rear window, and tailgate step with integrated work surface practical elements that make everyday tasks easier.

Inside, the cabin puts technology and comfort at your fingertips. The SYNC 4 system with an 8-inch productivity screen in the instrument cluster offers voice recognition and seamless smartphone integration. Dual-zone automatic temperature control, leather-wrapped steering wheel, and 10-way power seats with heated fronts create a comfortable workspace whether you're commuting or managing a job site. The onboard 400W outlet and Pro Power Onboard 7.2KW system provide reliable power for tools and equipment.

Safety and driver assistance features include forward sensing, rain-sensing wipers, evasive steering assist, intersection assist, and a 360-degree camera system that gives you complete visibility. The Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Pro Trailer Backup Assist make towing straightforward and secure.

This F-150 XLT represents a fully capable truck with the features professionals and truck enthusiasts value. Come experience the combination of hybrid efficiency, off-road capability, and modern technology firsthand.

description: This 2020 Toyota 4Runner Limited offers the capability and comfort you need for both daily driving and weekend adventures. - All-Weather Floor Liners and Cargo Tray Package - Premium JBL Audio with Navigation - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration - Moonroof with Tilt and Slide Function - Heated and Ventilated Front Bucket Seats with Leather Trim - Power Driver and Passenger Seats with Memory - Rear-View Camera with Parking Assistance - Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control - Garage Door Opener (HomeLink) - Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control - 4-Wheel Disc ABS Brakes - 20-Inch Dual 6-Spoke Alloy Wheels - SiriusXM Satellite Radio - Split-Folding Rear Seat for Flexible Cargo Space The 4.0L V6 engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability delivers dependable performance whether you're navigating city streets or exploring rugged terrain. The driver-focused layout gives you easy access to all primary controls, while the telescoping and tilting steering wheel accommodates your preferred driving position. Speed-sensing steering adjusts responsiveness based on vehicle velocity, providing stability during highway driving and maneuverability in tighter situations. Inside, the cabin reflects the Limited trim's commitment to refinement. Heated and ventilated front seats keep you comfortable throughout changing seasons, while leather seat trim adds a touch of sophistication. The dual-zone automatic climate control ensures both front passengers can maintain their preferred temperatures independently. Memory seat settings allow you to recall your customized position each time you enter the vehicle. Technology integration keeps you connected and informed. The navigation system works seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, providing multiple options for route planning and music streaming. The premium JBL audio system with 15 speakers delivers rich sound quality, complemented by SiriusXM satellite radio for consistent entertainment. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to manage your media without taking your hands off the wheel. Safety features are comprehensive and proactive. Dual front impact airbags, front and rear side-impact airbags, and knee airbags work together with the anti-whiplash front head restraints. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control maintain grip during challenging driving conditions, while low tire pressure warnings alert you to potential issues. The rear-view camera provides visual assistance when backing, and the emergency communication system with Safety Connect offers added peace of mind. The white exterior complements the Limited trim's polished appearance, while body-color bumpers and heated power mirrors maintain visual cohesion. Body-color spoiler and roof rack rails combine function with clean styling. At 16 city MPG and 19 highway MPG, fuel efficiency remains reasonable for a vehicle in this class with this capability level.
